requirements.text: The portal should allow patients to book, cancel, and reschedule appointments online.
Patients should be able to request repeat prescriptions without having to call the clinic.
A user-friendly interface with clear instructions or guides should be included to assist less tech-savvy users.
The portal should provide easy access to communicate with clinic staff, including a chat feature and a clearly displayed contact number.
Robust security measures must be implemented, including identity verification processes, to protect patient information.
The patient portal must be integrated carefully with existing processes and systems to avoid disrupting the current workflow.
